author: Cinna Davis (OpenAI Codex assisted)
statement: For raw charged pieces with polynomial shift weights of degree at most b, any linear extraction annihilating q-degrees below d has length support threshold e=d-b and exact structural rank given by a minimum threshold cover. Positive limiting e/h forces leading label-capacity loss and a quantified necessary grade increase; this is not a SAT bound.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the proof and asymptotics
Scalarization, output capacity and both crossing ranks remain open; arbitrary charge-dependent normalization is not covered
Relate any filter to full algorithmic costs before claiming a SAT improvement
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; author-checked, no independent or formal review
